verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 112.8 (-0.6% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 800, 85s 2,300 and 86s 5,000. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-06T03:40:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Nico Paz 87 Destined for Glory after its 31% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 200,000 coins. Now 188,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 30.7% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 6 so far, averaging -1.7% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Yannick Carrasco 84 Team of the week after its 77% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 11,750 coins. Now 12,250. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 77.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 5 of 10 so far, averaging +6.5% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 800 (0.96 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,300 (1.10 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,000 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,700 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Morgan Rogers and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Morgan Rogers 85 Team of the week -71.8%; Yannick Carrasco 84 Team of the week -66.9%; Kerolin Nicoli 86 Team of the week -66.0%; Jan Paul van Hecke 83 Team of the week -62.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Tijjani Reijnders SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 65.4K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
